headline: RBI grants Authorised Dealer Category-II licence to Mufin Green Finance
hook: New forex and remittance powers unlocked

modes.bear: Licence adds regulatory compliance burdens without guaranteeing immediate material financial contributions.
modes.bull: AD-II licence broadens Mufin's business scope into forex and remittances, adding a new operational revenue channel.
modes.simple: Mufin Green Finance received permission from the RBI to handle certain foreign exchange and money transfer services, widening its business scope.

summary: The Reserve Bank of India has granted an Authorised Dealer Category-II (AD-II) licence to Mufin Green Finance. This licence allows the company to undertake specific foreign exchange and non-trade related outward remittance transactions. For retail investors, this regulatory approval expands Mufin's operational capabilities in the financial services sector. It is a notable compliance milestone for the non-banking financial company.
why_it_matters: Expands foreign exchange service capabilities for Mufin Green Finance.

headline: Mufin Green Finance secures RBI license for forex and remittance services
hook: New forex license for Mufin Green Finance
summary: Mufin Green Finance has been granted an Authorised Dealer Category-II (AD-II) license by the Reserve Bank of India. This allows the company to conduct forex conversion, outward remittances under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme, and trade-related forex services. The firm also reported strong Q2 FY27 results, with total income rising 83% to ₹89.58 crore and net profit jumping 149% to ₹15.06 crore. This expansion into the forex market adds a new revenue stream to its existing green finance operations.
why_it_matters: New revenue stream opens for the company beyond green lending.

headline: Mufin Green Finance releases corporate investor presentation
hook: Routine disclosures to the stock exchange
summary: Mufin Green Finance Limited has submitted its latest investor presentation to the stock exchanges. These decks typically outline the company's operational performance, strategic roadmap, and financial metrics. Retail investors can review the presentation to track business growth and asset quality in the green financing segment. The filing provides transparent access to corporate updates for existing and prospective shareholders.
why_it_matters: Review business metrics and future growth plans for Mufin Green.

headline: Mufin Green Finance reports September quarter financial results
summary: Mufin Green Finance Limited has submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides official data on the company's financial performance during the quarter. Indian retail investors tracking the company can review these numbers to assess its operational progress.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data available for shareholder review.
